instruction: Configure aggressive auto-save at 2-minute intervals to ensure maximum data protection.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save interval to 2 minutes in LibreOffice Impress via Tools > Options > Load/Save > General settings. The evaluator uses the existing check_auto_saving_time metric to verify the AutoSaveTimeIntervall value in registrymodifications.xcu matches 2 minutes. This is a paraphrased variation of the original task with a different time interval.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) that contains auto-save settings
Metric function check_auto_saving_time correctly parses the XML file and navigates to the correct path (/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document)
Metric correctly extracts the AutoSaveTimeIntervall property value and compares it to the expected 2 minutes
Expected value semantically matches the instruction requirement (2-minute intervals)
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the main instruction requirement
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly as expected parameter and accesses expected['minutes']
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor consideration: The instruction says 'Enable aggressive auto-save' which might imply checking both that auto-save is enabled AND the interval is set. The current metric only checks the interval value. However, in LibreOffice, setting AutoSaveTimeIntervall to a specific value typically implies auto-save is enabled, so this is likely acceptable in practice.
